title: Choose SANAD’s new visual world
question: The screenshot sets the light and material language. Choose the SANAD world that should carry it across web and mobile.

options.label: Holographic Remittance Folio
options.lineage: security-thread banknotes, bilingual remittance slips, and modern mobile finance
options.thesis: One invoice becomes a luminous, tamper-conscious folio whose shared cost decision is readable at a glance.
options.viewport: Chat opens inside a tall pearl-white instrument with a lilac security glow; the invoice bridge is the single saturated object and Finance enlarges the receive amount into the page’s anchor.
options.risk: The glow can feel cosmetic unless every color band maps to a real state or cost consequence.

raised.raise: Every state also has a crisp binary mark, so softness never weakens certainty.
Buyer and supplier consequences align on a strict bilateral axis.
The agreement reveal is one deliberate exposure sequence, not scattered animation.
The invoice, comparison, and signed record visibly remain one continuous object.

options.label: Mashrabiya Daylight Ledger
options.lineage: sunlight through geometric screens onto a merchant’s working table
options.thesis: Cost clarity appears as patterned daylight moving across a precise bilingual ledger.
options.viewport: A cropped geometric light field frames the conversation while a porcelain invoice tray bridges into an exact two-party Finance ledger.
options.risk: It is the most culturally immediate direction and therefore the one most likely to become decorative if the geometry is overused.

options.label: Parametric Arabic Counterseal
options.lineage: generative identity driven by the agreement’s live parameters
options.thesis: A geometric Arabic seal, palette, and dividers resolve together as the deal becomes complete.
options.viewport: The SANAD seal sits large behind the active task while quote selection changes its geometry and bilateral completion closes the mark.
options.case: Strong Arabic identity and memorable state behavior; slightly less immediate for comparing exact payment consequences.
options.risk: The live mark can compete with the numbers if its motion or scale is not disciplined.

options.label: One-bit Trade Desk
options.thesis: The deal operates as overlapping invoice, comparison, and signature windows.
options.viewport: A tiled conversation window opens a separate full-height cost window with inverted selected states.
options.case: Very clear state mechanics, but neither the requested luminous language nor SANAD’s cultural identity survives.
options.risk: The deliberate friction reads as nostalgia rather than trust.

options.label: Safelight Agreement Lab
options.thesis: The agreement develops through fixed stations until both signatures reveal the final record.
options.viewport: The invoice sits in a developer tray while quote tests appear as stepped exposure strips.
options.case: Excellent commitment sequence, but the dark environment fights the screenshot and daytime operating context.
options.risk: Amber urgency overstates risk in a calm review task.

options.label: Bilateral Cost Score
options.thesis: Buyer and supplier costs move along mirrored columns toward a shared signed centerline.
options.viewport: The transfer route rises through a symmetrical buyer/supplier score with the invoice at the center.
options.case: The bilateral structure is excellent, but the unfamiliar notation adds decoding to a task that needs instant financial clarity.
options.kept: Strict bilateral alignment of payer and recipient consequences.
options.risk: The score can turn exact costs into an abstract diagram.

options.label: Single-sheet Agreement
options.lineage: an orizuru sequence folded from one uncut sheet
options.thesis: The invoice folds into a comparison and then a sealed agreement without losing its origin.
options.viewport: One square document changes form through the workflow while its source figures remain on visible facets.
options.case: Continuity is powerful, but the physical-fold metaphor does not identify SANAD’s audience or requested luminous material.
options.kept: Visible continuity from invoice to signed record.
options.risk: Folding can hide information exactly when comparison matters.

options.label: Arabic Letter Weather
options.lineage: letters condensing into words and reshaping a landscape
options.thesis: Arabic and Latin letterforms gather into the shared terms, then settle into a signed seal.
options.viewport: The Arabic name forms a weather front behind the conversation and condenses around the final agreement.
options.case: The identity is memorable, but transforming typography competes with dense operating content.
options.kept: One unmistakable identity gesture at hero scale.
options.risk: Readable bilingual naming can collapse under expressive motion.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished mobile fintech dashboard with white cards, one brand gradient, and familiar comparison rows.
canonCard.viewport: A compact header, account summary card, chat list, and conventional cost-comparison cards.
canonCard.risk: Immediately usable but visually interchangeable with consumer finance products.
